newsitem.title: CHILE: Israel's Peres to visit Chile.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Peres to visit Chile.

text.p: Former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres will pay a three-day visit to Chile next month at the invitation of local socialist parties, party leaders said on Friday.
Peres, leader of Israel's Labour Party, is scheduled to arrive in Santiago on April 9 from Argentina and hold talks with President Eduardo Frei the following day.
Peres will visit the port of Valparaiso and unveil a mural in homage to assassinated Israeli prime minister Yitzhak Rabin.
He is scheduled to fly from Chile to Brazil on April 11.
